_doc: Themes for the 12 starter Google posts (plan.py turns them into a post plan). Every theme is fact-light on purpose: it rests on the customer's own services, photos, area, booking link and pasted reviews, or on general car-care knowledge that claims nothing about the business. 'needs' says what must exist for the theme to be used: service (a site service), photo (one of their photos), reviews (pasted reviews to quote word for word), booking (a booking link), area (a city or service area), phone (a business phone). Tips come from tipsByType for the business type, in order; seasons from seasonal by month.

themes.title: Who we are
themes.angle: Introduce the business: what they do and where, in their own words from the intake (story, why customers choose them). No years, awards or claims they didn't give.

themes.title: Service spotlight
themes.angle: One of their site services: what the customer gets, written from the site's service description and the intake. One post per main service, in the site's order.

themes.title: Recent work
themes.angle: Show one of their photos (a before/after pair when they have one): what was done, from the photo and its note. Never guess the car model or the products used unless the note or intake says so.

themes.title: Care tip
themes.angle: A general car-care tip for their trade (tipsByType), useful on its own, ending with an invitation to book. Advice, not claims about the business.

themes.title: Seasonal reminder
themes.angle: What the season does to a car where they work (seasonal), and the service of theirs that helps.

themes.title: How to book
themes.angle: How booking works through their site: pick a service, pick a time. Only what the booking link really offers.

themes.title: Where we work
themes.angle: The city or service area they gave (mobile: we come to you only when they are mobile; shop: the address area).

themes.title: In our customers' words
themes.angle: Quote one pasted review word for word, with the name exactly as given (or no name). Never edit, combine or invent a review.

themes.title: Our new website
themes.angle: The new site is live: what visitors find there (services, photos, booking when there is a booking link).
